sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for Chisone and BR-310 is for Pinerolo (PLT-PIN). The ASL has no entry for Beinasco (PLT-BEI), and the 2026-11-06 re-audit did not add part approvals. Shipping to Beinasco is therefore not released.

sources.quote: BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,
Moving production to another site is a change of source.

A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: BR-310 belongs to the Nordhavn Fjell programme (PRG-Y). Moving it from Pinerolo to Beinasco counts as a change of source under the Nordhavn requirements. That needs written Nordhavn approval (PPAP) before the first shipment. No document in force covers it. DEV-125 only covers packing.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 cracking. BR-310 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T5, which is the same alloy family, and the 8D was raised on BR-310 itself.
